description.value: Zoomak Korean Tavern is a refined Korean restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, taking its name from the traditional Korean roadside tavern that once sheltered and fed travelers — a fitting spirit for a cycling-friendly stop. The kitchen presents authentic Korean dishes — lettuce wraps with grilled galbi, hand-made dumplings, spicy soft-tofu stew, and Korean fried chicken — alongside dedicated lunch and dinner menus and a happy-hour drinks program.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (12 spaces) at 44m; stands (2 spaces) at 51m; stands (4 spaces) at 58m. Total: 18 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully confirms the business is an active Korean restaurant at 52 Alexander St in Gastown, Vancouver, with phone 604.620.1240 and email info@zoomakyvr.com corroborating the discovered URL. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, takeout) are mentioned anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null. The menu contains several vegetarian-friendly dishes (Japchae with mushrooms and vegetables, Dolsot with a tofu option, vegetarian-compatible appetizers) though not explicitly labeled as such.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone number; phone 604.620.1240 was sourced entirely from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Gastown with a confirmed website, full menu, and contact details. A useful dining stop for touring cyclists riding through central Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: Reservations handled via OpenTable per the contact page. Closed Sundays.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Japchae (glass noodles with mushrooms and assorted vegetables), Dolsot Stone Bowl with tofu option, and vegetarian appetizers such as Bugak & Tuigak (crispy nori and konbu); not explicitly labeled vegetarian but plant-based choices are present across both lunch and dinner menus

wow_evidence: refined Korean restaurant in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Lunch/dinner mains $18–$32, mostly $20–$29; casual Korean tavern
